findings.summary: The node's sole required artifact audits/methodology-compliance.md was never produced — it exists in no commit (git log --all is empty for it) and no worktree location, and the evaluated subject_diff (base a7226d2 → tip 32a243b) is empty (file_count 0). The node's entire purpose — a final compliance audit re-checking every design-review/audit criterion against the finished product with cited evidence — is unfulfilled; all three acceptance criteria therefore scan indeterminate (0.2/0.5/0.1) in the deterministic result.

The only change this node's job (job_20260825T0359459637017660935a, attempt 1) made was to audits/design-review.md — an artifact owned by the still-provisional upstream design-review node — six line-citation edits (verify.rs:196→239, keymap.rs:365-372→416-425, dashboard.rs:296-361→296-328, keymap.rs:76-86→62-75, app.rs:2213-2221→2235-2247). This violates artifact ownership and repeats the exact harm pattern the graph itself documented in audits/design-review.md lines 6-9 (a prior attempt blocked for 'edited the upstream audit's evidence'). Silently amending another node's evidence in place is also what the node's own honesty criterion forbids (report as findings, never silently absorb).

The node ran while its dependency review-product-coherence was only 'provisional' with no artifact (reviews/product-coherence.md absent; no reviews/ directory exists), violating the node constraint 'Runs only after review-product-coherence corrects the product' and the deliberate ordering stated in review-product-coherence.yaml ('Runs BEFORE audit-methodology-compliance; this ordering is deliberate'). An audit executed before any review correction existed cannot satisfy the node's invariant that graph claims are evidenced against the finished, corrected state.

integrity.reasoning:
Fresh-eyes review of the terminal node audit-methodology-compliance. The node's role is unambiguous from its YAML and why: it is the last gate that re-runs the Phase-1 methodology and the design-review-named criteria against the finished, review-corrected product and produces audits/methodology-compliance.md with per-claim file/behavior citations, honestly recording passes and failures, and it runs only after review-product-coherence has corrected the product.

The work under review does none of that. The deterministic result shows the evaluated diff (base a7226d2 → tip 32a243b) is empty, the required artifact is absent (artifacts_present false), and all three criteria are indeterminate. Repo inspection confirms: audits/methodology-compliance.md exists in no commit and no directory; the only mutation made during this node's job window was a six-line citation edit to audits/design-review.md — the design-review node's artifact, which is itself provisional. That mutation is exactly the 'edited the upstream audit's evidence' harm pattern the graph's own design-review.md header (lines 6-9) documents a prior attempt being blocked for. And the run happened while the upstream review-product-coherence was still provisional with no reviews/product-coherence.md artifact, so the explicit ordering constraint ('Runs only after review-product-coherence corrects the product') was not satisfied.

Intent is not preserved: no audit evidence was produced; the node's promised deliverable does not exist. Graph integrity is not preserved: the run mutated another node's provisional artifact (ownership violation) and fired ahead of its deliberately ordered dependency gate. Because the change actively harms both the node's role and the graph's integrity, and because these are high-severity, evidence-backed problems, the verdict is block with required human review. A human should determine why the executor edited design-review.md instead of writing methodology-compliance.md and why the frontier fired with a provisional, artifact-less upstream before any re-run.
